spectral_primary.representation: flattened per-charge 288x41 spectral transmittance after subtracting development-only patchwise pooled mean
spectral_primary.transform: signed log1p after development-only residual centering

lab_secondary.representation: flattened per-charge 288x3 measured Lab after subtracting development-only patchwise pooled mean

pipeline: StandardScaler fit on development groups only
PCA full SVD retaining 95 percent development variance with maximum 32 components
family_model.selection: maximum mean leave-one-calendar-year-out development balanced accuracy; ties choose smaller C

calendar_year_only: balanced L2 logistic regression using the same C selection
batch_error_only: balanced L2 logistic regression using the same C selection

branch_rules.pass: retain cross-charge target-family physical distinguishability only; operator fitting remains forbidden
branch_rules.family_fails: close target-family identifiability under this representation
branch_rules.nuisance_wins: close as calendar-year or manufacturing-error shortcut
branch_rules.spectral_only: retain spectral material evidence; do not infer display appearance
branch_rules.lab_only: treat as target aim/manufacturing evidence unless independently replicated spectrally

claim_ceiling: batch-held-out target-family measurement identifiability only; no exact Ektachrome stock, camera-scene pair, digital-to-film operator, stock appearance, calibration, latent mode, production or redistribution claim
